findings.result: Finite coefficient descent uses closed subgroup preimages, Baire category and finitely many coset representatives; the cocycle sets are subgroups because the action already lies over E. It does not invoke the false arbitrary-compact-subset assertion.
The full infinite cyclotomic kernel is the literal fixed group of all ell-power roots; no finite cyclotomic or residual substitute.

Checked source CuspSub, IsRegAlg, cap_highest, HasSatGL, IsSatVecGL, satEig, DualIsConj, and AttachedSys definitions. Requested and obtained explicit maximal-parabolic-to-all-parabolics Fubini step. Geometric Frobenius, q^((n-1)/2), and integral dominant highest weights are consistent.

BLGGT section 2.1 and Theorem 2.1.1 provide the normalized semisimple attached representation and total oddness. The character delta_K^n has the required infinity sign and trivial norm pullback. Its Galois multiplier at c is -1, giving a symmetric polarization. Schur identifies the original pairing up to scalar; differentiation yields the original full negative-transpose action.

Inertia coboundaries and crystalline tensor primitives match the two local kernels. The graph projection is a topological identification; local coefficient retractions are E-linear, hence continuous on finite fields, and commute with the diagonal tensor action. Each place may use its own finite extension. Full M_n and the scalar line are retained.

Verified Thorne Theorem 6.1 directly: rank n>=2, CM field, regular algebraic cuspidal polarized pair, and irreducibility on the infinite cyclotomic extension suffice. No bound on the prime or residual-image condition is imposed in this theorem. The later split/unramified/Iwahori assumptions are internal reductions.

Averaging eliminates the non-annihilator characters with factor bd2/2. The prime-sum error 2Q/x divided by D=Qd2/2 is exactly 4/(d2*x). The positive-target coefficient and omitted-character contribution give (4+4o)*x^(1/2+epsilon). The individual gap bound is not used.

Taking the positive part of the averaged gap bounds H_+ because D>0. For theta>1/2+epsilon the additional power term has the displayed convergent weighted integral. Applying the hypothesis with alpha/2 absorbs that term on sufficiently late windows. Measurability is explicit.

limitations: This is a mathematical review of the stated published-theorem application and conditional analytic weakening. It does not prove the published theorems afresh, replay Lean, supply the compatible arithmetic data, or close HOST_RIGID_S.
